## Description

Builds a long-short portfolio of high- versus low-quality firms using profitability, growth, safety and payout characteristics.

## Where it may fit

Long-horizon cross-sectional stock selection; often used as a defensive or multi-factor sleeve.

## Vehicles

Long-short equity, factor funds and quantitative portfolios.

## Required data

Point-in-time fundamentals, profitability and leverage measures, earnings stability/growth, payout data, prices and short availability.

## Caveats

Factor definitions and regional implementation differ; updated datasets can change; control for sector, size, value and implementability.
